priority_1.workout_details: 15 min Zone 2 warm-up with 3x 15-sec high-cadence spin-ups. Main set: 5x 4 minutes @ 285-295W (110-115% FTP, Cadence 95-105 RPM) with 3.5 minutes easy Zone 1 recovery between efforts. 15 min Zone 2 cool-down. Total time: ~65 mins.
priority_1.reason: Directly targets your performance metric (5-min power capacity) while capitalizing on a completely fresh TSB (+6.3). High-yield stimulus to re-ignite acute training load.

priority_2.workout_details: 15 min easy Zone 2 warm-up + dynamic drills. Main set: 5x 1000m @ target 5km race pace (HR Zone 4) with 90 seconds active walking/jogging recovery between sets. 10 min easy Zone 2 cool-down.
priority_2.reason: Provides a high-quality run stimulus to build 5km interval quality and heart rate efficiency, serving as a direct alternative if you prefer running today.

priority_3.session_title: Heavy Lower Body Torque & Aesthetic Upper Body Strength
priority_3.workout_details: 1. Barbell Back Squats: 4x6 @ 80% 1RM. 2. Romanian Deadlifts: 3x8. 3. Overhead Press: 4x6. 4. Barbell Bench Press: 3x8. 5. Heavy Sandbag Carry (70kg): 3x 40 meters. 6. Core Plank & Bicep Superset: 3 sets.
